quite a number of negative reviews on here, especially about reception.

I’ve been with the surgery 5 years and was previously with a surgery in the town centre, there is a noticeable difference with the two in how they deal with patients. The clinical team are great, Hazel and Dr. Colaluca are both lovely clinicians with a great deal of empathy. Dr. Colaluca especially has been really helpful in recent months as I’ve been dealing with some health issues.

The reception team, on the whole, are as kind, caring and empathetic. On the odd occasion, they perhaps could seem friendlier, but as a someone in a similar field myself I understand the sheer pressure they are under. No one has ever been rude, impolite or unempathetic. It’s important to remember that often, receptionists are answering back to back phone calls. You don’t know what that last caller was like and it’s surprising quite how abusive and aggressive patients can get with someone who is following policy and procedure. The questions they ask are relevant and simply trying to signpost patients to the best person to help them. Reception also issue my repeat prescriptions incredibly quickly and any queries I’ve had have been dealt with effectively. I have no complaints and it’s clear to me how hard they work alongside other staff in the surgery.

The e-consult service is brilliant, I’ve always received help same day if needed or within a suitable time frame. My only feedback? If I do an e-consult, just asking for a routine appointment and give in there a rough time frame for when I’m available, unless there’s a specific reason, asking me to call the surgery back almost defeats the point- I’m avoiding using the phone system so others who only have access to that can use it quicker. But this is so minor.

Highly recommend the surgery to anyone!",null,[0,161]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s0MGJrRXhPRlJLZEVWb1kyMXVXRk5MWVVkdGVsRRAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xebc736a66e8041d3!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOk40bkExOFRKdEVoY21uWFNLYUdtelE%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2s0MGJrRXhPRlJLZEVWb1kyMXVXRk5MWVVkdGVsRRAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi2lbjim7KTAxU8JWMBHci4OM0QoykIDSgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi2lbjim7KTAxU8JWMBHci4OM0Q0pMFCAsoAw"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFCQnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lSMVJPU205SVVGOWZSV2hFUTBFNVYyWmtVMW90WkRWM1pWYzNkMEZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpSYzBOYVRUQnRaMk00V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2twTVkzRnFNa3BLUzA4eFJrbG9kRFpwY1hSVVgzYxAB",["0x0:0xebc736a66e8041d3",null,1765270243233253,1765270243233253,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117090711223025259695/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Manuel Camacho","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocK2A5fmdhAEAwkkuG2ldQixBSYBH0mpWJuRdnfzoROiICwtdQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba5-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/117090711223025259695?hl=en"],"117090711223025259695",null,194,16,null,[1,7,1],5,["Local Guide · 194 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi2lbjim7KTAxU8JWMBHci4OM0Q7LoGCA8oAA"]]]],null,"3 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Like all NHS surgeries it is in high demand.
